records.measurement: Without4CzIPN, no chlorosulfonylation product and97% recovery of6b; withoutCu(acac)2,5% chlorosulfonylation and13% cyclic oxysulfonylation.
TEMPO reduces chlorosulfonylation to30% with26% substrate recovery; an allyl–TEMPO adduct is detected byHRMS. A1,1-diphenylethylene trap gives56% sulfonyl trapping product.

Source voltammetry gives−0.77V for Cu(acac)2 and−0.84V for PhSO2Cl vsSCE inMeCN; no6b reduction peak is observed between−2 and2V. Cu(acac)2 quenches excited4CzIPN more strongly than the other measured reactants.
